description: Backend foundation - FastAPI application with project structure, AI integration layer, knowledge base indexing, file upload/parsing, and research workflow engine
steps: Create backend/ directory with FastAPI project structure: main.py, routers/, services/, models/, schemas/, utils/, tests/
Create backend/requirements.txt with dependencies: fastapi, uvicorn, python-multipart, python-docx, openpyxl, markdown, openai, pydantic, pytest, httpx, python-jose, aiofiles
Create backend/app/main.py with FastAPI app, CORS middleware (allow frontend origin), and health check endpoint

Create backend/app/models/research_project.py with Pydantic models for the research workflow phases: ProblemDescription, RefinedProblem, ResearchQuestion, SpecificProblems, Objective, SpecificObjectives, MethodologicalFramework, StateOfArtMatrix, VariableConceptualizationMatrix, DataCollectionInstruments
Create backend/app/models/workflow.py with WorkflowState model tracking current phase, completed phases, and all accumulated data per project

Create backend/app/services/ai_service.py with AIService class that supports multiple backends (OpenAI-compatible including NVIDIA integrate endpoint, configurable via environment variables). Methods: analyze_problem(), suggest_instruments(), refine_problem(), generate_research_questions(), validate_coherence(), generate_chapter()

Create backend/app/services/knowledge_base.py with KnowledgeBaseService that indexes all markdown files from skills/knowledge/, provides search/retrieval of relevant sections, and builds context prompts from the knowledge base content
Create backend/app/services/file_parser.py with FileParserService supporting .docx (python-docx), .xlsx (openpyxl), and .md (markdown) file parsing to extract text content

Create backend/app/services/document_generator.py with DocumentGeneratorService that generates APA 7 formatted documents (Word .docx output) for each completed chapter, following rules from the APA 7 manual in the knowledge base

Create backend/app/services/workflow_engine.py with WorkflowEngine class managing the step-by-step research process: phases are (1) Problem Identification, (2) Problem Refinement with 3 formulations, (3) Research Question, (4) State of the Art / Background with matrix, (5) Specific Problems, (6) Research Objective, (7) Specific Objectives, (8) Methodological Framework with variable conceptualization matrix, (9) Data Collection Instruments. Each phase validates coherence before advancing.
Create backend/app/routers/projects.py with CRUD endpoints for research projects

Create backend/app/routers/workflow.py with endpoints: POST /workflow/{project_id}/submit-input (submit text/files for current phase), GET /workflow/{project_id}/status (get current phase and tasks), POST /workflow/{project_id}/advance (advance to next phase after validation), POST /workflow/{project_id}/select-option (select from AI-generated options like problem formulations)

Create backend/app/routers/documents.py with endpoints: POST /documents/{project_id}/generate/{chapter} (generate APA 7 doc for a chapter), GET /documents/{project_id}/download/{chapter} (download generated document)
Create backend/app/routers/knowledge.py with endpoints: GET /knowledge/search?q=query (search knowledge base), POST /knowledge/upload (upload additional literature files)
Create backend/app/core/config.py with Settings class using pydantic-settings for AI provider configuration (api_key, base_url, model), app settings, and file storage paths

Create backend/app/core/prompts.py with all AI prompt templates for each workflow phase, incorporating methodology from the knowledge base books (scientific method steps, APA formatting rules, coherence validation criteria)
Create backend/tests/test_workflow.py with tests for the workflow engine phases and transitions
Create backend/tests/test_file_parser.py with tests for file parsing (docx, xlsx, md)
Create backend/tests/test_ai_service.py with tests for AI service (mocked responses)
Create a .env.example file at backend/.env.example with all required environment variables documented
acceptance_criteria: Running 'cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt' installs all dependencies without errors
Running 'cd backend && pytest tests/' passes all tests
Running 'cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000' starts the server and GET /health returns 200
The knowledge base service can load and search across all markdown files in skills/knowledge/
The workflow engine correctly tracks phases and prevents skipping ahead without validation
File parser correctly extracts text from .docx, .xlsx, and .md files
AI service is properly abstracted to support OpenAI-compatible endpoints via configuration
